Riley C.: Heads-up — AstraBio is requesting a dedicated POC pool in eu-west-3. They prefer H100 for low latency but asked about an A100 fallback. Need guidance on SKU, capacity, CIDR, and whether we can do a 30-45 day trial with waived commit.
Noah T.: Can you share workload profile? avg tokens, p95 target, and any peak/demo spikes?
Riley C.: Target is 320 qps for short diagnostics chat flows, p95 <=250ms for 512-token contexts. Expect demo spikes up to 800 qps for a few 10-min windows. Team: 5 devs + 1 security contact. They require EU data-only and customer-managed KMS. Also asked for private control plane option.
Sasha V.: For that latency and spikes, H100 is preferable. Suggest baseline 5xH100 with burst enabled to handle demo spikes. Alternative: 10xA100-80GB for more concurrent sessions but higher p95. We can enable burst (ephemeral capacity) but it depends on regional availability.
Noah T.: Network/security: we need a /28 CIDR for peering; if they want a private control plane, we'll require a second /28. Also need API key IP allowlist and an org-level KMS ARN. We'll fill the security questionnaire about SOC2, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, key rotation, and logging retention.
Riley C.: Can we provide a sample CLI snippet for their network folks and an estimated token-level cost for both SKU options for budgeting?
Sasha V.: Example internal rictl command to hand them:
```
rictl pool create --name astrabio-poc --region eu-west-3 \
  --sku h100 --count 5 --burst-enabled true \
  --control-plane private --vpc-peer-cidr 10.200.16.0/28 \
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-3:222233334444:key/efgh5678 \
  --contact security:infra@astrabio.com
```
Sasha V.: Perf estimate (rough): 5xH100 should sustain 320 qps with p95 ~180-260ms at 512 tokens with batching ~8. 10xA100 would give higher concurrency but p95 closer to 300-400ms. Burst will cover 800 qps demo windows if capacity is available.
Noah T.: Cost estimate (very rough): using expected monthly tokens ~320 qps * 3600 * 24 * 30 * avg 120 tokens/request -> ~265M tokens/month. H100 reserved route will be higher GPU-hour cost. I'll loop in Finance for a precise quote but ballpark numbers will go into the quote.
Riley C.: Timeline: can ops provision within 48-72 hours after we get CIDR + PO + KMS ARN? We want to run a demo mid next week.
OpsBot: Provisioning request received. Ticket #POC-9502 created. Ops review ETA 1 business day.
Sasha V.: Ops note: private control plane will add ~24 hours and requires the extra /28. Burst enablement may add another day depending on regional limits. We can usually get a 5xH100 test pool in eu-west-3 within 72 hours after approvals.
Riley C.: I'll ask Astra infra for CIDR and PO contact. Also please prepare security questionnaire responses and a minimal SLA for the POC.
Astra Infra (external): We can provide 10.200.16.0/28 and a list of dev IPs. PO is with legal; should be ready tomorrow. We will send KMS ARN once internal approval completes.
Noah T.: Add a canary route and auto-fallback to a quantized model config in the rollout so we can mitigate latency spikes. Also ensure token-level logging for billing audits.
Sasha V.: Agreed — we'll include canary pinning and fallback to a quantized variant, plus token-level usage logs.
Riley C.: Thanks. I'll follow up once PO + CIDR + KMS ARN are in and then request ops to start provisioning. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Ticket #POC-9502 updated — assignee: @Sasha V. — requested provisioning window: 2026-04-07 07:00 UTC.
